title: Visual Effects on "Boardwalk Empire"
content: Brainstorm Digitalcreated this video of visual effects breakdowns to show all the layers of elements that go into reconstructing a historical world on film.It's a good demonstration of the Emmy-award winning artistry of the people who work incompositing, an often-overlooked part of the visual effects industry that involves sophisticated judgments about edges, light, and color.Direct link to video
